cases.question: How far can a public-source evidence chain be proven from named farm relationships through corporate infrastructure, public money and political influence?

Scale.gap: No comparable animal-throughput time series is yet in the public ledger.

Farms/Suppliers.gap: Exact named-farm → slaughterhouse destination remains unproven.

Facilities.gap: Facility operation is proven; the named-farm shipment edge is not.

Brands.gap: Specific product/brand path from a named farm or facility is not yet proven.

Retail.gap: No named retailer relationship is asserted without retailer/manufacturer evidence.

Public Money.gap: Project participation is proven; exact recipient-level funding amount is not.

Procurement.gap: No awarded public contract to a mapped legal entity has been verified.

Lobbying.gap: Current Lobbyregister update requires version-aware review of historical/current expenditure claims.

Regulatory history.gap: Merger-control history is documented; this is not an animal-welfare enforcement finding.

Transition.gap: No comparable animal-impact transition time series is yet published.

cases.question: Can the same ZSI evidence model resolve a cooperative farm network, facilities and downstream market relationships without overclaiming?

Scale.gap: Comparable animal throughput and market-share claims are not yet in the ledger.

Facilities.gap: Facility list exists; legal operator/entity resolution should be deepened per site.

Brands.gap: Brand-to-legal-entity and product-flow edges not yet in the ledger.

Retail.gap: Broad retail relationships are described by the company, but no named retailer edge is asserted yet.

Procurement.gap: No awarded public contract mapped yet.

Lobbying.gap: Lobbyregister and association relationships not yet ingested.

Transition.gap: No comparable animal-outcome or transition time series yet.
